units.source_text: 他越发羡慕温柔的女子的身躯了。

en.t: He envied the bodies of gentle women all the more.

units.source_text: 他多想变成姐姐或妹妹啊。

en.t: How he longed to become an older sister or a younger sister.

units.source_text: 果真能变的话，不知该有多么新鲜，喜悦会使他全身发颤的。

en.t: If he really could change into one, how fresh it would feel; joy would make his whole body tremble.
